name: Sprout Social
tagline: Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management platform that combines publishing, engagement, analytics, and listening in a single suite. Its AI features include sentiment analysis, optimal send-time recommendations, and AI-assisted reply suggestions that help community managers respond to high volumes of messages consistently. Enterprise marketing and communications teams use it to manage social presence at scale with data-driven confidence.
